name: Dublin L.E.A.D. Summer Program
org: City of Dublin, Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Teens assist City of Dublin camp staff during summer camps and swim lessons. They get training in job skills, leading activities, water safety, and supervising campers.
who_can_apply: Teens entering 7th grade or higher. Complete the online application; staff review it and then tell you how to register. The page lists separate fees for Dublin residents and non-residents.
pay_detail: Registration fee for the 2026 program: $119 for Dublin residents, $143 for non-residents. No wage is stated on the page.
duration: The 2026 program ran June 8, 2026 to August 7, 2026. Participants are encouraged to help with recreation or aquatics programs for at least two weeks.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. The 2026 program ran June 8, 2026 to August 7, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Complete the online application when it is open (closed for 2026). Staff review it and then tell you how to register at dublinrecguide.com. Questions: Dublin.Lead@dublin.ca.gov.
notes: This is a fee-based training and volunteer-style program run by the city, not a paid job. Families pay the registration fee; the city page does not say teens are paid. The page does not name a residency rule for applying. Shifts are not pre-assigned; participants pick their own shifts in the registration system.
